page.welcome.title: Welcome to MaaAuto
page.welcome.desc: This wizard will guide you through installing MaaAuto.
page.welcome.intro:
The installer will automatically:
  • Download Python 3.11.9 runtime
  • Unpack program source
  • Install program dependencies (~200 MB, requires internet)
  • Build the main program locally
  • Deploy uninstaller / upgrader
  • Create desktop shortcut

This takes about 6-20 minutes depending on network and CPU.
